title: Flash Endurance Engineering for Write-Intensive Embedded Workloads: Extending SD Card Lifespan Through Kernel-Level Optimization
abstract_snippet: Low-cost flash has become the default storage medium for many embedded devices to date. Meanwhile, the endurance limits of flash memory have been a major reliability concern whenever such devices need to handle frequent writes, such as during intensive machine-learning workloads.
